title: Listen to your PC on your phone

hero.title: Keep your earphones on your phone.
hero.body: Stream PC audio over your private Wi-Fi at a café, library, or nearby. No need to switch your earphones between your PC and phone.
hero.captureNote: Captures the current Windows system audio mix. Choose the desired playback device in Windows Sound settings before broadcasting.

server.title: LAN server
server.description: Start the local service so phones on the same Wi-Fi can connect.
server.autoStart: Start the LAN server when AirEar opens

audio.title: Broadcast audio
audio.description: Electron captures the Windows system audio loopback and sends it to connected phones.
audio.cable: To keep PC speakers silent, set VB-CABLE as the Windows default output device.

phone.title: Connect a phone
phone.description: Open this address on a phone connected to the same Wi-Fi, enter the PIN, and tap Listen.
phone.waiting: Start the server to display the connection URL.
phone.noAddress: No private LAN address is available. Check your Wi-Fi connection.
phone.qrHint: The QR contains the address only. Enter the PIN separately.
phone.connectHelp: Connect both devices to the same private Wi-Fi and scan the QR code. Enter the PIN, then tap Listen in your phone browser.
phone.intro: Enter the access PIN shown in the AirEar desktop app.
phone.capacity: The maximum number of receivers is connected.
phone.notStreaming: Start audio broadcasting on the PC first.
phone.connectionFailed: The audio connection failed. Please reconnect.
phone.tapPlay: Tap Play to start the audio.
phone.volume: Use your phone volume buttons to adjust listening volume.
phone.earphonesTitle: One pair of earphones, less switching
phone.earphones: Connect your earphones to this phone. PC audio arrives over the same Wi-Fi.
phone.airpods: AirPods or other Bluetooth earphones paired with your phone work as usual.
phone.background: Playback while locked or in the background may be limited by iOS/Android and browser power policies.

security.notice: Private LAN only. HTTP signalling is not encrypted. Use a trusted Wi-Fi network and do not forward this port to the internet.

settings.title: Application settings
settings.firstUpdate: The first Electron release uses a Windows setup program. Existing Python EXE users must run the new installer once.

diagnostics.title: Logs & diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Logs are stored in your Windows user profile. PINs and session tokens are not written to them.

footer.screen: Playback while the phone is locked depends on browser and operating system behavior.

error.noAudioTrack: No system audio track was found.
error.capture: Could not start system audio capture.
error.signaling: Could not connect to the signalling service.
